psychological_meaning: Raven, a muted, cool-toned gray, evokes feelings of sophistication, neutrality, and a sense of calm introspection. It suggests reliability and practicality, yet can also hint at mystery and the unknown due to its association with the night. This color encourages a thoughtful and balanced perspective.
